title: Manyomi the Physician

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.28b.4), teaching Rava several remedies. In [Shabbat 133b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.133b.18), Rava expounded the matter in Mechoza, and the sons of Manyomi the physician tore their garments, etc.[^1]

notes.text: In Avodah Zarah Rava quotes the physician directly. Shabbat names the physician’s sons as the ones who tore their garments after Rava’s exposition. Compare [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2505&lang=en).
